narrative.overview: LENS is a bilingual desktop research harness. It takes the user-supplied Stitch workspace as an authorized starting point for hierarchy and rhythm, but maps it exclusively to LENS identity and live research data. The rail, canvas, and conditional inspector form a focused workspace rather than a fabricated IDE or permanent empty three-pane shell.
keyCharacteristics: Wide useful history rail, focused research canvas, and conditional inspector.
Real research events, sources, plans, reports, and graphs only.
Monochrome hierarchy with semantic status color.

rules.name: The Evidence-First Color Rule
rules.body: Color communicates a verified state; it never decorates an invented workflow or makes routine controls look important.

rules.name: The Reading-Then-Operation Rule
rules.body: Make the question and evidence easiest to read; make execution details available without making them louder than the answer.

rules.name: The Conditional-Inspector Rule
rules.body: A third region earns its space with an active, truthful artifact; it is not a permanent empty dashboard column.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: Separate work modes with structure first; add elevation only when it proves containment or focus.

dos: Translate the supplied Stitch structure and spacing into React components backed by LENS state.
Show only genuine research questions, events, tool activity, sources, plans, reports, and graph data.
Preserve Inter/Cairo, logical direction, visible focus, reduced motion, and dark/light semantic tokens.
donts: Do not retain Antigravity names, marks, blue/amber identity styling, decorative glows, gradients, or copied placeholder copy.
Do not display fabricated PRs, commits, test passes, terminal commands, repositories, scheduled work, source counts, or agent outcomes.
Do not sacrifice report readability, keyboard operation, or Arabic layout to reproduce a screenshot exactly.
